about.title: Thoughtful systems.
about.body: I’m Parth — a senior software engineer with 7+ years building enterprise web apps in React and TypeScript, focused on accessible UI and full-stack work in Node.js, Python, and Java. At Skillsoft I own the Skill Assessment module in LX-Studio, including agentic authoring workflows that cut assessment creation time by 60%.
experience.label: Experience
job.skillsoft.point0: Own full-stack development of LX-Studio’s Skill Assessment module — React with Python and Node.js — from assessment authoring and skill-based scoring through custom benchmarks and publishing for enterprise learners.
job.skillsoft.point1: Built agentic authoring workflows and LLM content generation with output evaluation and guardrails, cutting assessment creation time by 60%.
job.skillsoft.point2: Raised quality through code reviews, automated testing at 98% coverage, and production debugging.
job.icims.point0: Reduced candidate drop-off by 30% and raised application completion by 20% by removing friction from Hiring Suite career-site workflows.
job.icims.point1: Shipped Resume Per Job in 2.5 months against a 4-month commitment, owning it from implementation through production release.
job.icims.point2: Cut frontend maintenance by 30% and improved WCAG/ARIA coverage by moving from Redux to Redux Toolkit and from class components to React Hooks.
job.globallogic.point0: Developed reusable UI components for Ericsson white-label client deployments, cutting customer onboarding time by 40%.
job.globallogic.point1: Delivered iCIMS Hiring Suite features, defect fixes, and unit and integration tests.

projects.title: Side projects —
project.mm.description: One workspace for an Indian wedding: events, guest RSVPs, budgets, vendors, and a customizable wedding website. Login is required.
project.kd.description: Ask questions about lecture transcripts and get grounded answers with timestamped citations. Hybrid RAG blends semantic and keyword retrieval with self-correcting guardrails.
project.dm.description: An assistant that decides when to search the web, streams tool progress live, and lets conversations branch into independent threads with full auth and persistence.
project.sa.description: Sends one prompt to OpenAI, Gemini, and Mistral in parallel, streams every answer, then synthesizes a single best response with an evaluator model.
